name: Ploutos Money USDC priced from the BTC/USD feed
summary: Ploutos Money, an Aave V3 fork, had its AaveOracle USDC source repointed by the asset-listing admin to Chainlink's BTC/USD proxy, pricing 1 USDC near BTC. In the next block a searcher flash-borrowed a few USDC, supplied them as collateral and borrowed the WETH reserve; a liquidation bot in the same block seized a USDC borrower's USDT collateral for cents.
notes: Admitted under the privileged-action clause: an admin setAssetSources call created the mispricing and unrelated searchers exploited it. Shared funding via a high-volume hot wallet and the project's later disappearance hint at insider coordination, which onchain transfers do not establish; if shown, exclude.

The same-block liquidation by an unrelated bot used the BTC-priced USDC debt to seize the borrower's USDT collateral, so it is campaign. The later liquidation of the attacker's own position, after the source was replaced, is not an exploit.
Loss is aWETH and aUSDT depletion from loss.mjs. The flash-borrowed USDC collateral the attacker left and the liquidator's USDC repayment are not netted.
